notes: Founding-create Welcome sizes for the White Noise profile, measured by marmot-app's tests::relay_event_limits::a_bulk_create_fits_a_known_limit_up_to_the_fixture_boundary with the real engine, peeler and relay-plane adapter (mdk#2334).
members counts the founder, so a create sends members - 1 gift wraps, one per invitee, all the same size.

mls_welcome_bytes is the MLS Welcome; rumor_json_bytes the kind 444 rumor JSON; seal_json_bytes the kind 13 seal JSON, which is the gift wrap's NIP-44 plaintext; gift_wrap_json_bytes the signed kind 1059 event JSON, the size relays limit and size classes bucket.

Rows: a two-member chat, then the largest roster whose gift wrap fits 64 KiB (65,536 bytes) and the next one up. NIP-44 padding grows the wrap in steps, so the boundary moves only when the codec does.
When the codec changes, the test fails and prints the measured rows; replace these with them, keeping the two rosters on either side of 64 KiB.
